speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with a psychiatric condition and a new onset movement disorder; to begin our evaluation, have you noticed any recent changes in your mood, behavior, or thought patterns?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is great news regarding your psychiatric symptoms. Given that you started risperidone two months ago, have you noticed any involuntary movements in your face, tongue, or limbs, such as tremors, stiffness, or repetitive motions?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Inability to remain still, persistent feeling of restlessness. I also have Frequent fidgeting, Repetitive crossing and uncrossing of legs, Pacing.

speaker: Doctor
text: The symptoms you describe—restlessness, fidgeting, and an inability to sit still—sound like akathisia, a common side effect of risperidone. Have you noticed any muscle stiffness, tremors, or drooling, or has this feeling been constant since starting the medication? Also, have you experienced any changes in your sleep or appetite recently?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Recently diagnosed with schizophrenia. No other significant past medical history. Social history: College student, lives with parents. Denies tobacco, alcohol, or drug use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for providing that history; it confirms you have no prior medical issues and no substance use. Given your age and the specific symptoms of restlessness and fidgeting after starting risperidone, I need to check your vital signs to see if you have a rapid heart rate or high blood pressure. REQUEST TEST: Vitals including Heart Rate and Blood Pressure. REQUEST IMAGES: Please provide a brief description of whether you have noticed any muscle stiffness or drooling in addition to the restlessness.
